<script>
  if (typeof CustomMegaMenu === 'undefined') {
    class CustomMegaMenu {
      constructor() {
        this.container = document.getElementById('MegaMenuDrawer');
        if (!this.container || this.container.classList.contains('js-initialized')) return;

        this.triggers = document.querySelectorAll('a[data-megamenu-trigger]');
        this.mainPanels = this.container.querySelectorAll('.mega-menu__panel');
        this.subPanels = this.container.querySelectorAll('.mega-menu__sub-panel');
        this.linksWithChildren = this.container.querySelectorAll('a.mega-menu__link.has-children');

        this.triggers.forEach(trigger => trigger.addEventListener('click', this.openMegaMenu.bind(this)));
        this.container.querySelector('.mega-menu__close-button').addEventListener('click', this.closeMegaMenu.bind(this));
        this.container.querySelector('.mega-menu__overlay').addEventListener('click', this.closeMegaMenu.bind(this));
        this.linksWithChildren.forEach(link => link.addEventListener('click', this.openSubPanel.bind(this)));
        this.container.classList.add('js-initialized');
      }

      openMegaMenu(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        const handle = event.currentTarget.getAttribute('data-megamenu-trigger');
        const targetPanel = this.container.querySelector(`.mega-menu__panel[data-handle="${handle}"]`);
        if (!targetPanel) return;

        this.subPanels.forEach(panel => panel.classList.remove('is-active'));
        this.linksWithChildren.forEach(link => link.classList.remove('is-active'));

        this.mainPanels.forEach(panel => panel.style.display = 'none');
        targetPanel.style.display = 'flex';

        this.triggers.forEach(t => t.classList.remove('is-active'));
        event.currentTarget.classList.add('is-active');

        this.container.style.visibility = 'visible';
        this.container.classList.add('is-open');
        document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      }

      closeMegaMenu() {
        this.container.classList.remove('is-open');
        document.body.style.overflow = '';
        this.triggers.forEach(t => t.classList.remove('is-active'));
        
        setTimeout(() => {
          if (!this.container.classList.contains('is-open')) {
            this.container.style.visibility = 'hidden';
          }
        }, 400);
      }
      
      openSubPanel(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        const targetPanelId = event.currentTarget.getAttribute('data-target-panel');
        const targetPanel = this.container.querySelector(`#${targetPanelId}`);
        if (!targetPanel) return;

        // **FIX:** Check if the clicked item is already active
        const isAlreadyActive = event.currentTarget.classList.contains('is-active');

        // First, clear all existing active states
        const parentList = event.currentTarget.closest('.mega-menu__list');
        parentList.querySelectorAll('.mega-menu__link').forEach(link => link.classList.remove('is-active'));
        this.subPanels.forEach(panel => panel.classList.remove('is-active'));

        // If it wasn't already active, make it active now. If it was, it remains closed.
        if (!isAlreadyActive) {
          event.currentTarget.classList.add('is-active');
          targetPanel.classList.add('is-active');
        }
      }
    }
    new CustomMegaMenu();
  }
</script>

    });

    function startTimer() {
      let countdownEndTime;
      
      
        // No offer data available, exit
        console.log('🔥 No offer data available, timer not started');
        return;
      
      
      const daysEl = timerBlock.querySelector('[data-days]');
      const hoursEl = timerBlock.querySelector('[data-hours]');
      const minutesEl = timerBlock.querySelector('[data-minutes]');
      const secondsEl = timerBlock.querySelector('[data-seconds]');

      function updateTimer() {
        const now = new Date().getTime();
        const distance = countdownEndTime - now;

        if (distance <= 0) {
          clearInterval(timerInterval);
          daysEl.textContent = '00';
          hoursEl.textContent = '00';
          minutesEl.textContent = '00';
          secondsEl.textContent = '00';
          return;
        }

        const days = Math.floor(distance / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
        const hours = Math.floor((distance % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60));
        const minutes = Math.floor((distance % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
        const seconds = Math.floor((distance % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);

        daysEl.textContent = String(days).padStart(2, '0');
        hoursEl.textContent = String(hours).padStart(2, '0');
        minutesEl.textContent = String(minutes).padStart(2, '0');
        secondsEl.textContent = String(seconds).padStart(2, '0');
      }
      
      updateTimer();
      const timerInterval = setInterval(updateTimer, 1000);
    }
    
    startTimer();
  });
</script>

<script>
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    // Check if Splide is defined
    if (typeof Splide === 'undefined') {
      console.error('Splide.js is not loaded. Please ensure it is included in your theme.');
      return;
    }

    const switchSliders = document.querySelectorAll('.switch-slider');
    if (switchSliders.length > 0) {
      // --- Splide Carousel Initialization ---
      const splide = new Splide('.switch-slider', {
        perPage: 3,
        gap: '1.5rem',
        pagination: true,
        arrows: false,
        breakpoints: {
          1024: {
            perPage: 2,
          },
          768: {
            perPage: 1,
          },
        },
      });
      splide.mount();

      // --- Audio Player Logic ---
      const audioButtons = document.querySelectorAll('.switch-card__sound-btn');
      let currentlyPlaying = null;

      audioButtons.forEach(button => {
        const audioId = button.dataset.audioId;
        const audio = document.getElementById(audioId);

        if (audio) {
          button.addEventListener('click', () => {
            if (currentlyPlaying && currentlyPlaying !== audio) {
              currentlyPlaying.pause();
            }
            
            if (audio.paused) {
              audio.play();
            } else {
              audio.pause();
            }
          });

          audio.onplay = () => {
            currentlyPlaying = audio;
            document.querySelectorAll('.switch-card__sound-btn').forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove('is-playing'));
            button.classList.add('is-playing');
          };

          audio.onpause = () => {
            if (currentlyPlaying === audio) {
              currentlyPlaying = null;
            }
            button.classList.remove('is-playing');
          };
          
           audio.onended = () => {
            currentlyPlaying = null;
            button.classList.remove('is-playing');
          };
        }
      });
    }
  });
</script>

  <script>
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      const stickyATC = document.getElementById('md-sticky-atc-sticky-atc');
      if (!stickyATC) return;
      
      const mainAtcButton = document.querySelector(`#ProductInfo-sticky-atc [name="add"]`);
      const threshold = mainAtcButton ? mainAtcButton.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY : 600;

      window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
        if (window.scrollY > threshold) {
          stickyATC.classList.add('show');
        } else {
          stickyATC.classList.remove('show');
        }
      }, { passive: true });
      
      const productForm = document.querySelector(`product-form[data-section="sticky-atc"]`);
      if (productForm) {
        productForm.addEventListener('variant:change', (event) => {
          const variant = event.detail.variant;
          if (!variant) return;

          const imageEl = stickyATC.querySelector('.sticky-atc__image');
          const priceEl = stickyATC.querySelector('.sticky-atc__price');
          const titleEl = stickyATC.querySelector('.sticky-atc__title');
          const hiddenInput = stickyATC.querySelector('[name="id"]');
          const addButton = stickyATC.querySelector('[name="add"]');
          const addButtonText = addButton.querySelector('span');

          if (imageEl && variant.featured_image) {
            imageEl.src = `Liquid error (sections/sticky-atc line 218): invalid url input`.replace('', variant.featured_image.src);
          }
          
          if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = 'Nut 65 Aluminium Wireless Mechanical Keyboard';

          if (priceEl) {
            const formatMoney = (price) => new Intl.NumberFormat('INR', { style: 'currency', currency: 'INR' }).format(price / 100);
            
            let priceHTML = `<strong>${formatMoney(variant.price)}</strong>`;
            if (variant.compare_at_price > variant.price) {
              priceHTML += ` <s>${formatMoney(variant.compare_at_price)}</s>`;
            }
            priceEl.innerHTML = priceHTML;
          }

          if (hiddenInput) hiddenInput.value = variant.id;

          if (addButtonText) {
            if (variant.available) {
              addButtonText.textContent = 'Add';
              addButton.removeAttribute('disabled');
            } else {
              addButtonText.textContent = 'Sold Out';
              addButton.setAttribute('disabled', true);
            }
          }
        });
      }
        // Listen for global variant changes dispatched from JS (product-info.js)
        window.addEventListener('product:variant:changed', (e) => {
          console.log('sticky ATC received variant change event', e);
          const payload = e.detail || {};
          const variant = payload.variant;
          if (!variant) return;

          const imageEl = stickyATC.querySelector('.sticky-atc__image');
          const priceEl = stickyATC.querySelector('.sticky-atc__price');
          const titleEl = stickyATC.querySelector('.sticky-atc__title');
          const hiddenInput = stickyATC.querySelector('[name="id"]');
          const addButton = stickyATC.querySelector('[name="add"]');
          const addButtonText = addButton && addButton.querySelector('span');

          // Resolve image URL from several possible variant shapes
          const resolveImageSrc = (v) => {
            // featured_media.src (used in product-info)
            if (v.featured_media && (v.featured_media.src || (v.featured_media.preview_image && v.featured_media.preview_image.src))) {
              return v.featured_media.src || (v.featured_media.preview_image && v.featured_media.preview_image.src);
            }
            // featured_image.src (older themes / product-form)
            if (v.featured_image && v.featured_image.src) return v.featured_image.src;
            // image.src
            if (v.image && v.image.src) return v.image.src;
            // direct src
            if (v.src) return v.src;
            return null;
          };

          // Update image: use resolved src when available
          if (imageEl) {
            const src = resolveImageSrc(variant);
            if (src) imageEl.src = src;
          }

          // Update title (product title stays same)
          if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = 'Nut 65 Aluminium Wireless Mechanical Keyboard';

          // Update price safely using Liquid currency value as fallback
          if (priceEl) {
            const formatMoney = (price) => {
              try {
                return new Intl.NumberFormat('INR', { style: 'currency', currency: 'INR' }).format(price / 100);
              } catch (err) {
                return (price / 100).toFixed(2);
              }
            };

            let priceHTML = `<strong>${formatMoney(variant.price)}</strong>`;
            if (variant.compare_at_price && variant.compare_at_price > variant.price) {
              priceHTML += ` <s>${formatMoney(variant.compare_at_price)}</s>`;
            }
            priceEl.innerHTML = priceHTML;
          }

          // Hidden input
          if (hiddenInput) hiddenInput.value = variant.id || '';

          // Update add button state
          if (addButton) {
            if (variant.available) {
              addButtonText && (addButtonText.textContent = 'Add');
              addButton.removeAttribute('disabled');
            } else {
              addButtonText && (addButtonText.textContent = 'Sold Out');
              addButton.setAttribute('disabled', true);
            }
          }
        });
    });
  </script>

<script>
  if (!window.customSearchDrawerInitialized) {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
      const searchDrawer = document.getElementById('CustomSearchDrawer');
      if (!searchDrawer) return;

      const openTrigger = document.getElementById('CustomSearchDrawerTrigger');
      const closeTrigger = document.getElementById('CustomSearchDrawerClose');
      const overlay = document.getElementById('CustomSearchOverlay');
      const searchInput = document.getElementById('Search-In-Drawer');
      const initialStateContainer = document.getElementById('DrawerInitialState');
      const resetButton = searchDrawer.querySelector('button[type="reset"]');

      const updateViewState = () => {
        const isInputEmpty = searchInput.value.trim() === '';
        initialStateContainer.classList.toggle('hidden', !isInputEmpty);
      };

      const openDrawer = () => {
        searchDrawer.classList.add('is-open');
        setTimeout(() => searchInput.focus(), 300);
      };

      const closeDrawer = () => searchDrawer.classList.remove('is-open');
      
      if (openTrigger) openTrigger.addEventListener('click', openDrawer);
      if (closeTrigger) closeTrigger.addEventListener('click', closeDrawer);
      if (overlay) overlay.addEventListener('click', closeDrawer);
      if (searchInput) searchInput.addEventListener('input', updateViewState);
      
      if (resetButton) resetButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
        setTimeout(updateViewState, 50);
      });

      // --- NEW: Typewriter Placeholder Animation ---
      const phrasesToAnimate = [
        'keyboards',
        'gaming mouse',
        'monitors',
        'headsets'
      ];
      const baseText = 'Search for ';
      let phraseIndex = 0;
      let charIndex = 0;
      let isDeleting = false;
      let animationFrameId;

      function typewriterEffect() {
        if (searchInput.value.trim() !== '') {
          // Stop animation if user is typing
          searchInput.setAttribute('placeholder', 'Search for...'); // Reset to default
          return;
        }

        const currentPhrase = phrasesToAnimate[phraseIndex];
        let displayText = '';

        if (isDeleting) {
          displayText = baseText + currentPhrase.substring(0, charIndex - 1);
          charIndex--;
        } else {
          displayText = baseText + currentPhrase.substring(0, charIndex + 1);
          charIndex++;
        }

        searchInput.setAttribute('placeholder', displayText);

        let time = isDeleting ? 80 : 150;

        if (!isDeleting && charIndex === currentPhrase.length) {
          time = 2000; // Pause after typing a phrase
          isDeleting = true;
        } else if (isDeleting && charIndex === 0) {
          isDeleting = false;
          phraseIndex = (phraseIndex + 1) % phrasesToAnimate.length;
          time = 500; // Pause before typing next phrase
        }
        
        animationFrameId = setTimeout(typewriterEffect, time);
      }

      // Start the animation when the drawer opens
      openTrigger.addEventListener('click', () => {
        clearTimeout(animationFrameId);
        typewriterEffect();
      });

      // Stop the animation if the user starts typing
      searchInput.addEventListener('input', () => {
        clearTimeout(animationFrameId);
        if (searchInput.value.trim() === '') {
          // If they clear the input, restart the animation
          typewriterEffect();
        }
      });
    });
    window.customSearchDrawerInitialized = true;
  }
</script>

<script>
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    const drawerId = 'HelpDrawer';
    const drawer = document.getElementById(drawerId);
    if (!drawer) return;

    const openDrawer = (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      drawer.classList.add('is-open');
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    };

    const closeDrawer = () => {
      drawer.classList.remove('is-open');
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    };

    // Use event delegation for triggers
    document.body.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (e.target.closest(`[data-drawer-trigger="${drawerId}"]`)) {
        openDrawer(e);
      }
      if (e.target.closest('[data-drawer-close]')) {
        closeDrawer();
      }
    });

    // Close with escape key
    window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape' && drawer.classList.contains('is-open')) {
        closeDrawer();
      }
    });
  });
</script>
